senses.gloss: f. = h. שִׁבּוֹלֶת, current of a river.
units: Targ. Jud. XII, 6 אימר כען ש׳ ואמר סוּבַּלְתָּא say now, shubbalta, and he said, subbalta.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37">Lev. R. s. 37</cite> <he>אחדת להון שב׳ דנהרא</he> (not <cite ref="J00114"><he>יהב</he></cite>) the current of the river seized and carried them off.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> <cite ref="O00235"><he>סוּבַּלְתָּא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="S01403"><he>קְלַף</he></cite>.
